# zenasoft-ops-tools: build output, do not edit here

Every file in this repo is written by `release-speedrunner.sh`.
The next release overwrites any change committed here.

## Where the source lives

The source is the `__HubSpot - Nightly` repo, on the ZenaTech Marketing OneDrive library.

| Here | Source in Nightly |
|---|---|
| `plugins/zenasoft-speedrunner/shared/`, `briefs/`, `field-guide.html` | `_toolbox/page-factory/` |
| `plugins/zenasoft-speedrunner/` (everything else) | `_toolbox/zenasoft-speedrunner/zenasoft-speedrunner/` |
| `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `SETUP.md`, this file | generated by the release |

## Release

From Nightly: `bash _toolbox/one-shots/release-speedrunner.sh --bump patch`.
The script bumps the version, packs, runs the consistency gate, pushes `main` and drops the OneDrive zip.

## A session without the source (a cloud session)

1. Make the change here, on a branch. Do not bump the version. Do not push `main`.
2. Export it: `git format-patch -1 -o .`
3. Give the patch file to Tom.
4. Tom imports it in Nightly: `bash _toolbox/one-shots/import-speedrunner-patch.sh <patch>`.
   Then he runs the release.
